content:
laura_sre: FYI: Scheduled KV cache rebalance + prefix purge this Friday 2026-04-03 01:00-03:00 UTC. Purpose: reduce tail eviction storms and even out hot-prefix distribution across racks. Affects: eu-central, us-west-2 edge racks.
laura_sre: High level flow: 1) canary purge in eu-central-1c (5% traffic) -> 20m observation -> 2) incremental ramp (25% -> 60% -> 100%) across racks with stage gates. Purge removes prefixes older than 28 days and rebalances slot map.
infra_bot: Event created: "KV rebalance + prefix purge" scheduled 2026-04-03T01:00:00Z (link: https://ops.internal/events/2026-KV-REBAL-01).
mike_oncall: Oncall ack, I'll be watching edge_kvcache_evictions, inf_latency_p95, route_error_rate, and infra_gpu_mem.
laura_sre: Runbook quick-ops: start canary -> `POST /infra-api/ops/route-shift {"policy":"kv-purge-hedge","percent":5}`.
laura_sre: Rollback conditions: if infer_p95 > baseline*1.18 for 10m or 5xx_rate > 0.5% absolute -> set percent 0 and scale down purge cron. Commands: `POST /infra-api/ops/route-shift {"policy":"kv-purge-hedge","percent":0}` and `kubectl scale cronjob kv-rebalance-purge -n infra --replicas=0`.
laura_sre: To pause without rollback: tag purge job with `pause=true` via config service: `infractl job update kv-rebalance-purge --set pause=true`.
kevin_eng: We'll run a soft rewarm first to avoid thundering herd. Use `tools/soft_rewarm.py --workers 6 --rps 150`. Add to runbook?
laura_sre: yes please, add it. Rewarm guidance: limit aggregate rewarm qps per AZ to 200, stagger prefixes by random jitter up to 60s.
sasha_prod: Do we need customer comms? Any Dedicated tenants in us-west-2 who might see >10% p95 shift?
laura_sre: Product: prepare a small blurb for Support if p95 increases >10% sustained for 30m. We'll not proactively notify otherwise.
mike_oncall: I'll pre-create watchlist: edge.kvcache.canary.hit_ratio, edge.kvcache.global.evictions_per_min, infra.gpu.mem.free. Also adding dashboard panel for canary racks label set: region=eu-central,group=kv-canary.
infra_bot: Configuration deployment queued: `kv-rebalance-purge@infra` at 2026-04-03T01:00Z by laura_sre.
laura_sre: Note on risk: Rewarm traffic might increase token cost and transiently raise p95 on small models. We have throttles: `inference.max_concurrent_tokens` and `route.batch_size_override`. Both are fast toggles via config service.
kevin_eng: I'll add a temporary token cap per model route for the window, lowered by 20% as a precaution, revert after 02:30 if metrics stable.
mike_oncall: Who's shadowing canary? I can if kevin wants me to run rewarm script.
kevin_eng: Sure, lean on me to run rewarm and watch backend TTFB. I'll keep the soft-rewarm script in infra/tools/rewarms/ and tag runs in the runbook.
laura_sre: I'll paste the runbook link and the triage checklist here before the window. Link: https://confluence.internal/infra/kv-rebalance-purge. Incident page: https://incident.internal/INC-2026-KVREBAL.
mike_oncall: I'll post status updates in this thread during the run and create a postmortem draft if anything anomalous occurs.
sasha_prod: If any Dedicated customer is affected, please cc support@redwood-inference and include tenant id + observed metrics.
laura_sre: Final ops note: if mem pressure on GPU rises unexpectedly after purge due to rehydration, fallback path: 1) reduce purge ramp to 0%, 2) throttle rewarm (set soft_rewarm --rps to 50), 3) enable smaller batchers in AZ via `infractl route update --batcher=small`.
kevin_eng: Got it. I'll also add a short log line generator so runbook events correlate to logs: `logger.info("kv-rebalance: step=%s percent=%d", step, percent)`.
laura_sre: Thanks team. Ping here if you want to shadow. I'll start a preflight check at 00:15 UTC day-of.
